tldr: 台股週一再跌221.57點收42,449.70點，上週崩跌後賣壓仍重，惟台積電漲30元至2,320元撐盤。
記憶體股領軍反攻，大摩上修DDR4供給缺口至約兩成，南亞科、華邦電亮燈漲停，記憶體續為盤面最熱題材。
金管會核准玉山金併三商美邦人壽，合併基準日暫定9月1日，年底拚更名玉山人壽。
財富管理面，土地銀行成為第25家取得財管2.0執照的銀行，全台高資產客戶達2.2萬人、管理資產2.3兆元。
海外方面，美股週一因晶片反彈熄火收黑，布蘭特油價因美對伊朗連九夜空襲站上90美元，本週Alphabet、Tesla、Intel、IBM財報為AI關鍵考驗。

items.title_zh: 台股收跌221點至42,449 賣壓延續 台積電撐盤
items.title_en: TAIEX falls 221 points to 42,449 as post-crash selling lingers; TSMC props up the index
items.summary_zh: 台股週一收跌221.57點（-0.52%）至42,449.70點，成交值約9,838億元，延續上週急跌、融資籌碼持續清洗。台積電逆勢漲30元至2,320元、鴻海協助撐盤，但盤面弱勢、跌停約18檔，被動元件承壓。市場關注前波低點42,006點與40,000點心理關卡能否守穩，短線可能於區間震盪整理，投資人宜留意去槓桿節奏與權值股評價修正進度。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan benchmark closed Monday down 221.57 points (-0.52%) at 42,449.70 on turnover of about NT$983.9 billion, extending last week's sharp decline as margin positions kept unwinding. TSMC bucked the weakness, rising NT$30 to NT$2,320, and Hon Hai helped anchor the large caps, but breadth stayed poor with roughly 18 limit-down names and passive-component stocks under heavy pressure. Traders now watch the prior low near 42,006 and the psychological 40,000 zone as the next supports.

items.title_zh: 記憶體股領軍反攻 南亞科、華邦電亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Memory stocks lead a rebound as Nanya and Winbond go limit-up
items.summary_zh: 在大盤偏弱下，記憶體族群強勢逆襲：南亞科攻上漲停鎖死，華邦電大漲逾半根停板，反映DRAM供需缺口擴大與矽電容題材的重新評價潛力。資金明顯湧入帶動成交放大，凸顯記憶體為當前盤面主流領漲族群，即使大盤仍處修正整理。投資人須評估此波是真實的逢低承接或整理格局中的技術反彈，留意漲多後的獲利了結與題材延續性。
items.summary_en: Against a soft tape, memory names staged a sharp counter-rally: Nanya Technology locked limit-up and Winbond surged more than half a limit on widening DRAM shortage expectations and a re-rating tied to silicon-capacitor potential. The move drew heavy turnover into the group and underscored memory as the market's clear leadership theme, even as the broader index stayed in corrective mode. Investors are weighing whether the rebound marks genuine bargain-hunting or a technical bounce within an ongoing consolidation.

items.title_zh: 大摩上修DDR4缺口至約兩成 大升南亞科、華邦電目標價
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley lifts DDR4 shortage view to ~20% and sharply raises Nanya, Winbond targets
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利發布看多報告，將下半年DDR4供給缺口估值由約14%上修至19-20%，缺口延續至2027-2028年，並預期第3季DDR4價格季增幅上看約20%。大摩將華邦電目標價調升至222元（樂觀上看264元）、南亞科上修至380元，最樂觀情境甚至挑戰805元。此舉把成熟製程記憶體重新定位為高毛利循環，使台灣記憶體廠成為AI時代供應鏈焦點；惟須留意三星、海力士擴產與價格能否如期走揚的變數。
items.summary_en: In a bullish report, Morgan Stanley raised its second-half DDR4 supply-shortfall estimate to 19-20% (from about 14%), with the gap persisting into 2027-2028, and projected third-quarter DDR4 prices could climb around 20% quarter-on-quarter. The house lifted Winbond's target to NT$222 (up to NT$264 in a bull case) and Nanya's to NT$380, with an optimistic scenario as high as NT$805. The upgrade reframes mature-node memory as a high-margin cycle and keeps Taiwan memory makers central to the AI-era supply story.

items.title_zh: DDR4下半年嚴重短缺 原廠產能轉向HBM、DDR5
items.title_en: DDR4 seen "severely short" in H2 as makers pivot capacity to HBM and DDR5
items.summary_zh: 後續分析指出，DDR4供給缺口下半年持續擴大，三大原廠將產能導向高毛利HBM與DDR5，排擠標準型DRAM供給。此排擠效應支撐南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、力積電、愛普等個股評價調升；惟分析師示警2026-2027年積極擴產，恐使缺口最終收斂。對台灣供應鏈而言，短期定價力占優，但投資人宜追蹤庫存、資本支出與需求是否降溫，避免在情緒主導下追高，關注供需反轉訊號以控管風險。
items.summary_en: Follow-on analysis maps a deepening DDR4 squeeze into the second half, with the top-three makers steering capacity toward high-margin HBM and DDR5 and leaving legacy DRAM supply tight. That crowding-out dynamic underpins target-price upgrades across Nanya, Winbond, Macronix, PSMC and Etron, though analysts flag that aggressive capacity additions in 2026-2027 could eventually narrow the gap. For Taiwan's supply chain, the near-term setup favours pricing power, but investors are urged to track inventory, capex and any demand cooling rather than chase prices.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准玉山金併三商美邦人壽 合併基準日暫定9月1日
items.title_en: FSC clears E.Sun Financial's takeover of Mercuries Life; merger benchmark set for around September 1
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意玉山金控以股份轉換方式，將三商美邦人壽轉換為100%持股子公司，認定玉山金在保戶與員工權益保障、財務健全及長期經營承諾等均符合規定。合併基準日暫定9月1日，三商壽屆時下市，年底可望更名玉山人壽。此案重塑台灣壽險版圖，讓玉山金補齊銀行、證券、保險的全方位金融平台，市場關注後續整併綜效、資本配置與商品策略調整，以及對壽險同業競爭態勢的影響。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission approved E.Sun Financial Holding's plan to convert Mercuries Life Insurance into a wholly-owned subsidiary via share swap, ruling that E.Sun meets requirements on policyholder and employee protection, capital adequacy and long-term commitment. The merger benchmark date is tentatively September 1, with Mercuries Life to delist and the entity likely renamed E.Sun Life by year-end. The deal reshapes Taiwan's life-insurance landscape and gives E.Sun a full-service financial platform spanning banking, securities and insurance.

items.title_zh: 外資調節金融與記憶體股 金融類股承壓
items.title_en: Foreign investors trim financial and memory holdings, pressuring bank and insurer shares
items.summary_zh: 在大盤回檔之際，外資同步調節金融股與記憶體股，壓抑銀行與保險類股表現，惟金融業基本面仍屬穩健。此波賣壓反映風險趨避與前波漲多後的獲利了結，而非產業獲利前景轉弱，市場以殖利率與淨值支撐視為穩定力量。投資人關注指數波動趨緩、利率預期底定後，外資資金是否回補金融股，以及壽險業在新清償能力制度下的資本調整節奏與配息政策走向。
items.summary_en: Amid the market's pullback, offshore funds rotated out of financial stocks alongside memory names, weighing on banks and insurers even as the broader financial sector stays fundamentally sound. The selling reflects risk-off positioning and profit-taking after a strong run rather than a change in the sector's earnings outlook, with dividend yields and book-value support cited as stabilisers. Investors are watching whether foreign flows turn back to financials once index volatility subsides and rate expectations settle.

items.title_zh: 土銀取得財管2.0執照 成第25家搶攻高資產商機
items.title_en: Land Bank becomes the 25th bank licensed for high-asset "Wealth 2.0" services
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准台灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務（財管2.0），成為第25家取得執照的銀行，原則上年底前有望開辦。金管會統計至2月底，高資產客戶達22,199人、管理資產規模2兆3,044億元；商品配置以存款42.7%最高，其次基金17.1%、債券14.4%、保險11.9%、境外結構型商品7.4%。此案加劇本國銀行搶攻一站式私銀型服務的競爭，高資產客戶可望取得更多元的財富管理與傳承規劃選擇。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved Land Bank of Taiwan to offer financial products and services for high-asset clients (the "Wealth 2.0" regime), making it the 25th licensed bank and likely opening the business by year-end. Regulator data through end-February show Taiwan's high-net-worth pool has reached 22,199 clients with assets under management of NT$2.3044 trillion; allocation skews to deposits (42.7%), funds (17.1%), bonds (14.4%), insurance (11.9%) and offshore structured products (7.4%). The push intensifies competition for one-stop private-banking-style services among domestic banks.

items.title_zh: 2026存股族最愛ETF 0050、00919、00878領銜 破解配息迷思
items.title_en: 2026 stock-picking favourites: 0050, 00919 and 00878 top the list as payout-frequency myths persist
items.summary_zh: 2026年台股存股族最愛ETF盤點顯示，市值型與高股息如0050、00919、00878居前，主動式與科技型ETF熱度也升。專家強調，配息頻率（月配、季配、半年配）只改變現金流時點，不代表長期總報酬更高：月配適合需穩定現金流的退休族，市值型則更利於長期資產成長。建議投資人依理財目標搭配「收益＋成長」配置，而非單純追逐帳面最高殖利率，並留意填息與淨值波動風險，兼顧現金流與資產累積。
items.summary_en: A round-up of 2026's most-held ETFs among Taiwan's buy-and-hold crowd shows market-cap and high-dividend products such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 leading, alongside active and tech-themed funds. Advisers stress that distribution frequency — monthly, quarterly or semi-annual — changes cash-flow timing, not long-run total return: monthly payers suit retirees needing steady income, while market-cap ETFs better serve long-term growth. The guidance urges investors to blend income and growth by goal rather than chase the highest headline yield.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 財政部放寬繼承舊制房屋成本認定 依物價指數調整
items.title_en: MOF eases cost recognition for inherited old-regime homes, indexing values to inflation
items.summary_zh: 財政部7月中發布解釋令，個人出售因繼承或受贈取得、且適用舊制房屋交易所得課稅的房屋，計算課稅所得時得將取得時的房屋評定現值及公告土地現值，依物價指數調整後列為成交價額的減項。此舉透過物價指數化的成本認定，減少純因物價上漲而虛增的課稅所得，減輕家庭處分長期持有繼承房產的稅負。會計師提醒受影響家庭於出售前重新檢視成本基礎與持有紀錄，妥善試算並保留相關文件，以正確適用新令、降低稅務爭議風險。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued a ruling (mid-July) letting individuals who sell inherited or gifted homes taxed under the old property-income regime adjust the assessed house value and announced land value by the consumer price index when computing taxable gains. By allowing an inflation-indexed deduction, the change reduces the taxable gain inflated purely by rising prices, easing the tax burden on families disposing of long-held inherited property. Advisers say affected households should revisit cost basis and holding records before selling.

items.title_zh: 連續繼承房地得併計持有期間 有機會適用較低稅率
items.title_en: Holding periods across successive inheritances can be combined to lower rates
items.summary_zh: 呼應成本認定的放寬，稅捐機關重申，因連續繼承或受遺贈取得的房地，於適用房地合一所得稅時，得將各次被繼承人（遺贈人）的持有期間合併計算。由於房地合一稅率隨持有期間拉長而下降，併計持有期間有機會使交易適用較低稅率。對進行跨代財產移轉的家庭而言，明確化的規定使持有期間佐證成為稅務規劃核心，出售前宜完整保留歷次繼承文件與持有紀錄，並諮詢專業試算，避免適用錯誤稅制墊高稅負。
items.summary_en: Complementing the cost-basis relief, the tax authority reaffirms that when property is acquired through successive inheritances or bequests, taxpayers may aggregate the holding periods of each prior decedent when applying the consolidated house-and-land income tax. Because the regime's rates fall as the holding period lengthens, combining periods can move a sale into a lower tax bracket. For families managing multi-generational property transfers, the clarified rules make holding-period documentation central to tax planning ahead of any disposal.

items.title_zh: 中經院：2026成長「前高後穩」達7.22% CPI約1.98%
items.title_en: CIER sees 2026 growth "front-loaded then steady" at 7.22%, with CPI near 1.98%
items.summary_zh: 中華經濟研究院預測台灣2026年經濟成長率約7.22%，呈「前高後穩」：上半年強勁成長10.69%，下半年隨出口基期正常化溫和走穩至4.10%。全年CPI年增率估約1.98%、略低於2%，因油價補貼與電費凍漲減緩上漲壓力。AI帶動的需求使出口與投資維持穩健，惟機構示警全球貿易量成長放緩與基期偏高，將使下半年動能趨緩，民間消費可望增溫接棒。整體而言，總經維持穩健但增速回落，牽動央行政策節奏與資產評價。
items.summary_en: The Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research projects Taiwan's 2026 GDP growth at about 7.22%, following a "front-high, back-steady" path: a powerful 10.69% first half moderating to 4.10% in the second half as the export base normalises. Full-year CPI is seen around 1.98%, just under 2%, helped by fuel subsidies and frozen electricity rates. AI-driven demand keeps exports and investment firm, though the institute flags slowing global trade and a high base as reasons second-half momentum cools, with private consumption expected to pick up.

items.title_zh: 下半年開局震盪 油價與Fed利率風向定調總經
items.title_en: Investors eye a data-heavy second-half open as oil and Fed direction set the tone
items.summary_zh: 策略師勾勒台美投資人下半年開局的震盪格局，將一連串關鍵總經事件——油價升破90美元、本週大型科技財報與月底聯準會會議——視為牽動全球利率預期的變數。能源成本走高使台灣輸入性通膨疑慮再起，壓縮政策寬鬆空間；聯準會偏鷹立場則使匯率與資金流向前景不明。對投資人而言，重點在於觀察地緣政治與央行訊號，而非追逐短線波動，並留意油價與通膨對下半年利率路徑與台股評價的連動影響。
items.summary_en: Market strategists map a volatile second-half open for Taiwan and US investors, framing a run of key macro events — oil's surge past US$90, this week's megacap earnings and the late-July Fed meeting — as the swing factors for global rate expectations. Rising energy costs revive imported-inflation concerns for Taiwan, tightening the room for policy easing, while a hawkish-leaning Fed keeps the currency and capital-flow outlook uncertain. The takeaway: watch geopolitics and central-bank signals rather than chase short-term moves.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.title_zh: 台媒：美股七雄財報、晶片高估值與Fed利率成焦點
items.title_en: Taiwanese coverage: US "Magnificent Seven" earnings, stretched chip valuations and the Fed in focus
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體聚焦本週一波大型科技財報、偏高的半導體估值與聯準會利率風向。報導指出，費城半導體指數今年以來累漲約68%，英特爾大漲逾160%、德儀累積近70%漲幅，估值墊高使財報容錯空間有限。隨Alphabet、英特爾、德儀與特斯拉陸續公布財報，分析師認為業績須撐得起高本益比；油價走高則使通膨與利率風險續存。這些變數牽動台灣科技供應鏈與台股情緒，投資人須留意財報後的評價修正與資金輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: Taiwan market media frame the week around a wave of megacap results, elevated semiconductor valuations and the Fed's rate direction. Reports note the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is up roughly 68% year-to-date, with Intel surging more than 160% and Texas Instruments up nearly 70%, leaving little room for earnings disappointment. With Alphabet, Intel, Texas Instruments and Tesla all due, analysts say results must justify rich multiples, while oil's climb keeps inflation and rate risk in view — dynamics that ripple into Taiwan's tech supply chain and index sentiment.

items.title_zh: 油價升破90美元壓抑AI半導體 輝達、台積電、AMD齊跌
items.title_en: Oil above US$90 pressures AI semiconductors; Nvidia, TSMC and AMD fall together
items.summary_zh: 一份中文市場簡報指出，隨原油升破90美元，AI半導體族群集體承壓，輝達、台積電、AMD同步下跌。分析將此波弱勢歸因於能源成本走高帶動的通膨疑慮，以及地緣風險下資金撤出高估值晶片龍頭的輪動。對台灣投資人而言，此連動凸顯即便AI結構性需求未變，油價與利率動能仍可能壓抑晶片行情，宜採精選布局而非全面追逐晶片動能，並留意估值修正與資金板塊移動的風險。
items.summary_en: A Taiwanese-language market brief reports that with crude breaking US$90, AI-semiconductor names came under collective pressure, with Nvidia, TSMC and AMD all declining. The piece ties the weakness to rising energy costs feeding inflation worries and to a rotation out of high-valuation chip leaders amid geopolitical risk. For Taiwan investors, the read-across underscores how oil and rate dynamics can cap the AI trade even when structural demand stays intact, arguing for selective positioning rather than broad chasing of chip momentum.

items.title_zh: 美股走低 晶片反彈熄火、油價因伊朗攀升（2026-07-20）
items.title_en: US stocks slip as chip-rally fizzles and oil climbs on Iran (2026-07-20)
items.summary_zh: 美股週一收黑，半導體帶動的反彈熄火，加上油價上漲壓抑情緒。標普500指數跌0.19%至7,443.28點，道瓊工業指數跌307.16點（-0.59%）至51,839.26點，那斯達克綜合指數微跌0.05%至25,508.07點。蘋果重挫逾2%拖累道瓊，投資人為本週密集的大型科技財報審慎布局。油價在最新美伊軍事交火後走高，使能源與地緣政治風險持續成為市場焦點，觀望情緒濃厚。
items.summary_en: US equities closed lower Monday as a semiconductor-led rebound faded and rising oil weighed on sentiment. The S&P 500 fell 0.19% to 7,443.28, the Dow dropped 307.16 points (-0.59%) to 51,839.26, and the Nasdaq Composite edged down 0.05% to 25,508.07. A more than 2% drop in Apple pressured the blue-chip index, while investors braced for a heavy week of megacap earnings. Oil advanced after the latest US-Iran military exchanges, keeping energy and geopolitical risk front of mind.

items.title_zh: 油價跳漲約3% 美對伊朗連九夜空襲、布蘭特站上90美元（2026-07-20）
items.title_en: Oil jumps ~3% as US strikes Iran for a ninth straight night; Brent tops US$90 (2026-07-20)
items.summary_zh: 原油週一跳漲約3%，因美伊衝突限制荷莫茲海峽運輸。布蘭特原油漲2.77美元（3.14%）至90.87美元，西德州原油漲2.35美元（2.85%）至84.84美元；美國連續第九夜對伊朗空襲，盟友科威特與巴林通報遭伊朗攻擊。美方證實近期戰事至少三名軍人身亡，荷莫茲海峽通行船隻由前一日8艘降至4艘。油價本月以來已累漲約20%，地緣與能源供應風險升溫，市場關注是否轉向外交解決。
items.summary_en: Crude surged about 3% Monday as US-Iran hostilities restricted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Brent rose $2.77 (3.14%) to $90.87 and WTI gained $2.35 (2.85%) to $84.84 after the US carried out a ninth consecutive night of strikes and allies Kuwait and Bahrain reported Iranian attacks. The US confirmed at least three service members had died in recent fighting, and Hormuz transits fell to four vessels from eight a day earlier. Oil has climbed roughly 20% this month.

items.title_zh: 財報週登場：Alphabet、Tesla、IBM、Intel領軍 AI關鍵考驗（2026-07-19）
items.title_en: Earnings playbook: Alphabet, Tesla, IBM and Intel headline a pivotal AI-test week (2026-07-19)
items.summary_zh: 未來一週近80家標普500企業公布財報，由Alphabet、Tesla、IBM週三與Intel週四領軍。華爾街拉高標準，要求龐大AI基建支出開始貢獻營收：Alphabet將全年資本支出上調至最高1,900億美元、預估成長逾20%，其雲端與晶片業務被關注是否排擠其他硬體支出。IBM則在初步財報不佳、單日重挫25%創紀錄後跛行進場。市場檢視AI資本支出的變現能力，牽動科技巨頭評價與全球風險偏好，台廠供應鏈情緒亦受影響。
items.summary_en: Nearly 80 S&P 500 companies report in the week ahead, led by Alphabet, Tesla and IBM on Wednesday and Intel on Thursday. Wall Street has raised the bar, wanting proof that massive AI-infrastructure spending is generating revenue: Alphabet lifted full-year capex guidance to as high as US$190 billion and is expected to post 20%-plus growth, while its cloud and chip units are watched for signs hyperscalers are pulling spend from other hardware. IBM limps in after a record 25% one-day plunge on weak preliminary results.

items.title_zh: 晶片股領跌 投資人質疑AI估值過高（2026-07-19）
items.title_en: Chip stocks lead the pullback as investors question stretched AI valuations (2026-07-19)
items.summary_zh: 美媒對週一盤勢的報導凸顯半導體再度轉弱，晶片反彈熄火加上油價走高拖累主要指數收低。在關鍵財報前，投資人日益審視AI晶片族群偏高的估值，並在IBM創紀錄重挫、大型科技股財報將至下更趨謹慎。分析師提醒，即便財報季開局強勁，本週仍將面臨最大考驗，美伊地緣衝突升溫與能源成本上升，進一步加重對高估值科技龍頭的壓力，波動可能維持偏高，宜控管部位、分批因應。
items.summary_en: US coverage of the Monday session highlighted renewed weakness in semiconductors, with a fading chip rebound and rising oil dragging the major averages lower. Investors are increasingly scrutinising elevated valuations across the AI-chip complex ahead of key results, wary after IBM's record slide and with megacap reports looming. Analysts caution that even a strong earnings-season start faces its biggest test this week, as geopolitical escalation with Iran and higher energy costs add to the pressure on richly-priced technology leaders.
